CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.reject_immutable_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_table_schema='ingestion'
    and tg_table_name='food_projection_versions'
    and tg_op='UPDATE'
    and pg_catalog.current_setting(
      'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_hash_initialization',true
    )='1'
    and pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new)-'lifecycle_projection_hash'
      =pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old)-'lifecycle_projection_hash'
    and pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old)->>'lifecycle_projection_hash'=repeat('0',64)
    and pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new)->>'lifecycle_projection_hash'
      ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  then
    return new;
  end if;
  raise exception using
    errcode='55000',message='immutable ingestion evidence cannot be changed';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.derive_food_barcode_scope()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  parent_food record;
begin
  select
    foods.food_type,
    foods.is_public,
    foods.owner_user_id
  into parent_food
  from public.foods
  where foods.id = new.food_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Barcode parent food is unavailable.'
      using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if parent_food.is_public = true
    and parent_food.owner_user_id is null
    and parent_food.food_type <> 'user_custom'
  then
    new.scope_owner_user_id := null;
  elsif parent_food.food_type = 'user_custom'
    and parent_food.owner_user_id is not null
    and parent_food.is_public = false
  then
    new.scope_owner_user_id := parent_food.owner_user_id;
  else
    raise exception 'Barcode parent food has an unsupported ownership state.'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.recipe_id is distinct from new.recipe_id then

    set updated_at = now()
    where recipes.id in (old.recipe_id, new.recipe_id);
  else

    set updated_at = now()
    where recipes.id = case
      when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.recipe_id
      else new.recipe_id
    end;
  end if;

  return null;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.validate_nutrient_projection_evidence_link_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  projection ingestion.food_nutrient_projection_versions%rowtype;
  food_projection ingestion.food_projection_versions%rowtype;
  evidence ingestion.food_nutrient_evidence%rowtype;
  evidence_food_id uuid;
  evidence_nutrient_id uuid;
begin
  select * into projection
  from ingestion.food_nutrient_projection_versions
  where id = new.food_nutrient_projection_version_id;
  select * into food_projection from ingestion.food_projection_versions
  where id = projection.food_projection_version_id;
  select * into evidence from ingestion.food_nutrient_evidence
  where id = new.food_nutrient_evidence_id;
  select current_rows.food_id,current_rows.nutrient_id
  into evidence_food_id,evidence_nutrient_id
  from public.food_nutrients current_rows
  where current_rows.id = evidence.food_nutrient_id;
  if evidence_food_id is null
    and pg_catalog.current_setting(
      'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_execution_authorized',true
    ) = '1'
  then
    select items.current_food_id,nutrients.id
    into evidence_food_id,evidence_nutrient_id
    from ingestion.lifecycle_execution_plan_items items
    join public.nutrients nutrients
      on nutrients.code = projection.nutrient_code
    where items.id = nullif(pg_catalog.current_setting(
      'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_plan_item_id',true
    ),'')::uuid
      and coalesce(items.current_food_id,items.reserved_food_id)
        = food_projection.food_id;
  end if;
  if projection.id is null or evidence.id is null
    or projection.projection_state <> 'present'
    or evidence_food_id <> food_projection.food_id
    or evidence_nutrient_id <> projection.nutrient_id
    or evidence.source_record_version_id not in (
      select versions.id from ingestion.source_record_versions versions
      where versions.source_record_id = food_projection.source_record_id
    )
    or projection.basis <> evidence.original_basis
    or projection.amount <> evidence.original_value
    or projection.source_semantic is distinct from evidence.source_semantic
    or projection.source_nutrient_id <> evidence.source_nutrient_id
    or projection.source_unit <> evidence.original_unit
    or projection.derivation_code is distinct from evidence.derivation_code
    or projection.derivation_description
      is distinct from evidence.derivation_description
  then
    raise exception using errcode = '23514',
      message = 'nutrient projection evidence is incompatible';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.protect_lifecycle_run_transition_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if old.run_purpose <> 'initial_promotion'
    and new.current_state is distinct from old.current_state
    and new.current_state in ('validated','approved','promoting','completed')
    and not (
      (old.current_state='staged' and new.current_state='validated'
        and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting(
          'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_validation_authorized',true
        ),'')='1')
      or (old.current_state='validated' and new.current_state='approved'
        and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting(
          'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_approval_authorized',true
        ),'')='1')
      or (old.current_state='approved' and new.current_state='promoting'
        and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting(
          'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_execution_authorized',true
        ),'')='1')
      or (old.current_state='promoting' and new.current_state='completed'
        and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting(
          'nutrition_tracker.lifecycle_execution_authorized',true
        ),'')='1')
    )
  then
    raise exception using errcode='55000',
      message='lifecycle state requires a bounded lifecycle function';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.insert_completed_manual_diary_entry_request(p_idempotency_key uuid, p_request_payload jsonb, p_diary_entry_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_completed_at timestamptz;
  v_row_payload jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_current_account_access_allowed() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using
      message = 'account_access_required';
  end if;

  if v_user_id is null then
    raise insufficient_privilege using
      message = 'Authentication is required to complete a manual diary request.';
  end if;

  if p_idempotency_key is null
    or p_request_payload is null
    or jsonb_typeof(p_request_payload) <> 'object'
    or p_diary_entry_id is null
  then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using
      message = 'Manual diary request completion input is invalid.';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'entry_date', diary_entries.entry_date,
    'meal_type', diary_entries.meal_type,
    'food_id', diary_entries.food_id,
    'food_name', diary_entries.food_name,
    'brand_name', diary_entries.brand_name,
    'serving_quantity', diary_entries.serving_quantity,
    'serving_unit', diary_entries.serving_unit,
    'calories', diary_entries.calories,
    'protein_g', diary_entries.protein_g,
    'carbohydrates_g', diary_entries.carbohydrates_g,
    'fat_g', diary_entries.fat_g,
    'notes', diary_entries.notes
  )
  into v_row_payload
  from public.diary_entries
  where diary_entries.id = p_diary_entry_id
    and diary_entries.user_id = v_user_id
    and diary_entries.source = 'manual'
    and diary_entries.version = 1
    and diary_entries.xmin::text = pg_current_xact_id()::text;

  if found and p_request_payload -> 'contract_version' = '2'::jsonb then
    select v_row_payload || jsonb_build_object(
      'contract_version', 2,
      'additional_nutrient_snapshot', diary_entries.additional_nutrient_snapshot
    ) into v_row_payload
    from public.diary_entries
    where diary_entries.id = p_diary_entry_id
      and diary_entries.user_id = v_user_id
      and diary_entries.source = 'manual'
      and diary_entries.version = 1
      and diary_entries.xmin::text = pg_current_xact_id()::text;
  elsif found and exists (
    select 1 from public.diary_entries
    where diary_entries.id = p_diary_entry_id
      and diary_entries.additional_nutrient_snapshot is not null
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'Legacy receipts cannot omit a captured nutrient snapshot.';
  end if;

  if not found or v_row_payload is distinct from p_request_payload then
    raise check_violation using
      message = 'Receipt completion requires the matching manual diary row from the current transaction.';
  end if;

  insert into public.manual_diary_entry_requests (
    user_id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_payload,
    completed_diary_entry_id,
    live_diary_entry_id
  ) values (
    v_user_id,
    p_idempotency_key,
    p_request_payload,
    p_diary_entry_id,
    p_diary_entry_id
  )
  returning manual_diary_entry_requests.completed_at into v_completed_at;

  return v_completed_at;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_readable_food_nutrition_reference_v1(p_food_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(food_id uuid, name text, brand_name text, nutrient_basis text, serving_quantity numeric, serving_unit text, food_type text, data_quality text, is_owned boolean, source_id uuid, source_code text, source_name text, source_food_id text, source_updated_at timestamp with time zone, reference_fingerprint text, nutrients jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with manifest as materialized (
    select definition ->> 'code' as code, definition ->> 'unit' as unit
    from jsonb_array_elements(public.nutrient_snapshot_manifest_v1()) definition
  ), readable_food as materialized (
    select foods.*, food_sources.code as source_code,
      food_sources.name as source_name, food_sources.updated_at as source_revision
    from public.foods
    left join public.food_sources on food_sources.id = foods.source_id
    where auth.uid() is not null and public.is_current_account_activated()
      and foods.id = p_food_id and not foods.is_archived
  ), selected_basis as (
    select readable_food.*,
      case when readable_food.food_type = 'user_custom'
        then readable_food.custom_nutrient_basis
        else (
          select food_nutrients.basis
          from public.food_nutrients
          join public.nutrients on nutrients.id = food_nutrients.nutrient_id
          join manifest on manifest.code = nutrients.code and manifest.unit = nutrients.unit
          where food_nutrients.food_id = readable_food.id
            and (food_nutrients.basis <> 'per_serving'
              or (readable_food.serving_size > 0 and nullif(btrim(readable_food.serving_unit), '') is not null))
          group by food_nutrients.basis
          order by case food_nutrients.basis when 'per_serving' then 1 when 'per_100g' then 2 else 3 end
          limit 1
        ) end as selected_basis
    from readable_food
  ), reference_values as (
    select selected_basis.*,
      case selected_basis.selected_basis when 'per_100g' then 100 when 'per_100ml' then 100
        else selected_basis.serving_size end as reference_quantity,
      case selected_basis.selected_basis when 'per_100g' then 'g' when 'per_100ml' then 'ml'
        else selected_basis.serving_unit end as reference_unit,
      snapshots.amounts, snapshots.revisions,
      greatest(selected_basis.updated_at, selected_basis.source_revision, snapshots.updated_at) as reference_updated_at
    from selected_basis
    cross join lateral (
      select jsonb_object_agg(manifest.code, food_nutrients.amount::text order by manifest.code) as amounts,
        jsonb_object_agg(manifest.code, food_nutrients.updated_at order by manifest.code) as revisions,
        max(food_nutrients.updated_at) as updated_at
      from manifest
      left join public.nutrients on nutrients.code = manifest.code and nutrients.unit = manifest.unit
      left join public.food_nutrients on food_nutrients.nutrient_id = nutrients.id
        and food_nutrients.food_id = selected_basis.id and food_nutrients.basis = selected_basis.selected_basis
    ) snapshots
  )
  select reference_values.id, reference_values.name, reference_values.brand_name,
    reference_values.selected_basis, reference_values.reference_quantity, reference_values.reference_unit,
    reference_values.food_type, reference_values.data_quality,
    coalesce(reference_values.owner_user_id = auth.uid(), false), reference_values.source_id,
    reference_values.source_code, reference_values.source_name, reference_values.source_food_id,
    reference_values.reference_updated_at,
    encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object(
      'manifest_version', 1, 'food_id', reference_values.id,
      'name', reference_values.name, 'brand_name', reference_values.brand_name,
      'food_type', reference_values.food_type, 'data_quality', reference_values.data_quality,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_readable_food_nutrition_reference_v2(p_food_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(food_id uuid, name text, brand_name text, nutrient_basis text, serving_quantity numeric, serving_unit text, food_type text, data_quality text, is_owned boolean, source_id uuid, source_code text, source_name text, source_food_id text, source_updated_at timestamp with time zone, reference_fingerprint text, nutrients jsonb, catalog_serving_quantity numeric, catalog_serving_unit text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  -- STABLE functions and this single statement share the caller's MVCC snapshot.
  -- Both reads remain subject to the caller's table policies and v1 auth gate.
  select reference.food_id, reference.name, reference.brand_name, reference.nutrient_basis,
    reference.serving_quantity, reference.serving_unit, reference.food_type, reference.data_quality,
    reference.is_owned, reference.source_id, reference.source_code, reference.source_name,

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.verify_mapping_projection_v2()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
declare p ingestion.food_projection_versions; i ingestion.source_mapping_interpretations;
  prior ingestion.food_projection_versions; body jsonb; state_count bigint; linked_count bigint; present_count bigint;
begin
  select * into strict p from ingestion.food_projection_versions where id=new.id;
  select * into strict i from ingestion.source_mapping_interpretations where id=p.source_mapping_interpretation_id;
  select * into strict prior from ingestion.food_projection_versions where id=p.prior_food_projection_version_id;
  select count(*),count(*) filter(where projection_state='present') into state_count,present_count
    from ingestion.food_nutrient_projection_versions where food_projection_version_id=p.id;
  select count(*) into linked_count from ingestion.food_nutrient_projection_evidence_links l
    join ingestion.food_nutrient_projection_versions s on s.id=l.food_nutrient_projection_version_id
    join ingestion.food_nutrient_evidence e on e.id=l.food_nutrient_evidence_id
    where s.food_projection_version_id=p.id and e.source_mapping_interpretation_id=i.id
      and e.evidence_hash_v2=s.evidence_hash and e.mapping_version_id=p.mapping_version_id
      and e.source_record_version_id=p.source_record_version_id
      and e.mapping_reprojection_receipt_id=p.mapping_reprojection_receipt_id;
  body := ingestion.mapping_projection_body_v2(p.id);
  if state_count<>35 or linked_count<>present_count
    or p.dataset_id<>prior.dataset_id or p.environment<>prior.environment
    or p.food_id<>prior.food_id or p.source_record_id<>prior.source_record_id
    or p.source_record_version_id<>prior.source_record_version_id
    or (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(p)-array['id','prior_food_projection_version_id','origin_type',
      'initial_promotion_receipt_id','lifecycle_update_receipt_id','projection_hash','created_at',
      'normalized_candidate_hash','source_metadata_hash','lifecycle_projection_hash','projection_contract_version',
      'source_mapping_interpretation_id','mapping_version_id','mapping_reprojection_receipt_id','projection_body_v2'])
       is distinct from (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(prior)-array['id','prior_food_projection_version_id','origin_type',
      'initial_promotion_receipt_id','lifecycle_update_receipt_id','projection_hash','created_at',
      'normalized_candidate_hash','source_metadata_hash','lifecycle_projection_hash','projection_contract_version',
      'source_mapping_interpretation_id','mapping_version_id','mapping_reprojection_receipt_id','projection_body_v2'])
    or body->'nutrient_states' is distinct from ingestion.mapping_candidate_states_v1(i.candidate_body,p.origin_type='mapping_compensation')
    or p.projection_body_v2 is distinct from body
    or p.projection_hash<>ingestion.fingerprint_mapping_json_v1(body)
    or p.lifecycle_projection_hash<>ingestion.mapping_lifecycle_hash_v2(body) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='invalid or incomplete v2 projection';
  end if;
  return null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.guard_mapping_plan_transition_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op='DELETE' or pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new)-'state' is distinct from pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old)-'state'
    or not ((old.state='prepared' and new.state in ('validated','rejected','expired','abandoned'))
      or (old.state='validated' and new.state in ('approved','rejected','expired','abandoned'))
      or (old.state='approved' and new.state in ('completed','rejected','expired','abandoned'))) then
    raise exception using errcode='55000',message='immutable plan or invalid transition';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: ingestion.validate_mapping_registry_evidence_v1()
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ingestion.validate_mapping_registry_evidence_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare registry ingestion.nutrient_mapping_versions;
begin
  select * into strict registry from ingestion.nutrient_mapping_versions where id=new.mapping_version_id;
  if not exists(select from ingestion.source_datasets where id=registry.dataset_id and code='usda_fdc_foundation')
    or registry.version_code<>'usda-foundation-full35-direct-v2' or registry.content_sha256<>new.mapping_hash
    or registry.approval_status<>'approved'
    or (select count(*) from ingestion.nutrient_source_mappings where mapping_version_id=registry.id)<>33
    or exists(select from ingestion.nutrient_source_mappings r
      left join public.nutrients n on n.id=r.application_nutrient_id
      where r.mapping_version_id=registry.id and not exists(
        select from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(new.canonical_mapping->'mappings') m
        cross join lateral pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(m->'sources') s
        where s->>'id'=r.source_nutrient_id and s->>'name'=r.source_nutrient_name
          and m->>'application_nutrient_code'=n.code and m->>'application_unit'=n.unit and n.unit=r.application_unit
          and new.canonical_mapping->'unit_aliases'->n.unit ? r.source_unit
          and r.source_basis='per_100g' and r.mapping_status='supported'
          and r.exact_conversion_factor is null and r.conversion_classification='source_reported'
          and r.value_classification='source_reported' and r.missing_value_policy='preserve_unknown'
          and r.explicit_zero_policy='preserve_zero')) then
    raise exception using errcode='23514',message='registry must match the exact 33-source Full35 mapping';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.diary_governed_dataset_v1(p_food_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_ids uuid[]; v_owner uuid:=private.diary_reference_owner_v1();
begin
  if v_owner is null then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message='account_activation_required';
  end if;
  select pg_catalog.array_agg(distinct d.id) into v_ids
  from public.foods f
  join public.food_sources s on s.id=f.source_id and s.code='usda'
  join ingestion.food_source_links l on l.food_id=f.id
    and l.link_role='primary' and l.review_status='approved'
  join ingestion.source_records r on r.id=l.source_record_id and r.concept_key=f.source_food_id
  join ingestion.source_datasets d on d.id=r.dataset_id and d.code='usda_fdc_foundation'
  where f.id=p_food_id and f.is_public and f.owner_user_id is null and not f.is_archived and f.food_type='generic';
  if pg_catalog.cardinality(v_ids)>1 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='Ambiguous governed food identity.';
  end if;
  return v_ids[1];
end; $function$
